observations: Three photos show a large blue plastic drum with a red lid, placed outdoors on a concrete surface.
The drum has a white label with text and a barcode, but the text is not legible.
The drum has a black 'SA' marking on the side, possibly a seller's or inventory tag.
The drum appears to be used, with visible dirt, scuffs, and some water stains on the surface.
In the background, other drums (blue and white) are visible, suggesting a storage or sales yard.
The drum's shape is cylindrical with a slightly tapered bottom, typical of industrial drums.
No visible brand or model name is readable on the drum itself.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not visible on the drum in any photo. The label is too blurry to read the volume.

risks.risk: The drum may be damaged or cracked, especially at the base or seams, which is not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the base and seams of the drum, showing any cracks, warping, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value

risks.risk: The drum may have internal contamination or residue, which is not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the interior of the drum, or a sample of the contents if it is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly contaminated, which reduces value

risks.risk: The drum may not be suitable for the buyer's intended use (e.g., chemical storage, food, etc.) without further inspection.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or any markings indicating material type, chemical compatibility, or intended use.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified for intended use, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up of the capacity stamp on the drum.
Close-up photo of the base and seams to check for cracks or damage.
Photo or video of the interior of the drum.
Clear photo of the label or any markings indicating material type or intended use.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
